name: Simple Whipped Guacamole (No Onion, No Garlic, Seedless)
whyItWorks: Ripe Hass avocado whipped with a fork until creamy, seasoned only with extra virgin olive oil and fine sea salt. Packed with anti-inflammatory monounsaturated fats and soluble potassium, with zero onion fructans or spicy jalapeño seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mash 1 ripe avocado with 1 tsp olive oil and 1/4 tsp salt. Dip with Fritos corn chips or spread onto soft flour tortillas.
